name: Book appointments
summary: Checks free times, books, moves and cancels appointments in your Cal.com calendar, reading the time and email back before it books.

defaults.name: event_type_id
defaults.label: Event type id
defaults.help: The number in the event type's link in Cal.com (Event Types → the event → its id).

instructions_snippet: To book a time, check free times with {{ kit.tool.check }}, offer two or three of them, read the chosen time and the caller's email back, then book it with {{ kit.tool.create }}. To move or cancel a booking, find it first with {{ kit.tool.list }} using their email, and confirm before you change anything.

rules.label: Show that the time is booked

test_case.name: Books a time
test_case.persona_instructions: You are Demo Rao (demo.rao@example.com) and want an appointment tomorrow afternoon. Accept the first afternoon time offered and confirm your email when it is read back.
test_case.scenario: Ask for an appointment tomorrow afternoon.
expectations: The agent offers free times before booking.
The agent reads the time and the email back before it books.

variants.label: Cal.com
variants.summary: The six Cal.com booking tools, keyed by a Cal.com API key kept in a tool-secret key (without one the calls carry no key and Cal.com refuses them).
